summary: feat(settings): adopt Nova semantics in Settings
description:
Because:
- Settings components set colors with raw utilities and hand-written dark: pairs.
- Nova restyles Settings per the FxA Design System Figma and design review.
- The Connected Services rule and "Learn more" links had layout bugs (flag-off fixes).

This commit:
- Swaps exact pairs for semantic utilities; collapses other pairs under nova:.
- Restyles nav pills, dividers, device rows, Linked Accounts and mobile cards under nova:.
- Makes AlertBar a tinted pill; adds hover tints and canvas promos under nova:.
- Moves Switch, Checkbox, slider and focus rings to the Nova accent.
- Adds nova:-only utilities and documents mappings and gaps in the README.
